info.title: Pollinate API
info.description: External API for Pollinate - A flexible supply chain SaaS platform

basicAuth.description: Basic authentication using email and password. Use email as username and password as password.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token authentication. Also requires x-org-id header.

orgIdHeader.name: x-org-id
orgIdHeader.description: Organization ID for scoping the request

paginationLimit.name: limit
paginationLimit.description: Maximum number of results to return

partnershipTypeFilter.name: partnershipType
partnershipTypeFilter.description: Filter by partnership type (customer or supplier)

searchQuery.name: search
searchQuery.description: Text search across order references and notes

propertiesPath.name: propertiesPath
propertiesPath.description: JSONB path for property filtering (dot notation support)

propertiesValue.name: propertiesValue
propertiesValue.description: Exact value match for specified property path

propertiesExists.name: propertiesExists
propertiesExists.description: Check if property exists (true) or does not exist (false)

sortField.name: sort
sortField.description: Field to sort by (e.g., createdAt, updatedAt, status)

productSearchQuery.name: search
productSearchQuery.description: Search in product name, code, or description

userId.description: User identifier for the authenticated user

quantityInBaseUom.description: Quantity in base unit of measure
Quantity in base unit of measure (must be >= 0)
Quantity in base unit of measure (must be >= 0)

variants.description: Optional array of product variants to create
Array of variants. Variants with id will be updated (matched by id), variants without id will be created (if no matching name), and variants not in array will be soft-deleted.

count.description: Total number of products matching query

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default location

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the primary contact

locationId.description: Location identifier for delivery address population

packedBy.description: User ID of person who packed the order

shippedBy.description: User ID of person who shipped the order

deliveredBy.description: User ID of person who confirmed delivery

returnedBy.description: User ID of person who processed return

variantPartnershipPriceId.description: Variant Partnership Price identifier (alternative to variantId)

variantId.description: Variant identifier - will be resolved to Variant Partnership Price ID (alternative to variantPartnershipPriceId)

unitPrice.description: Price per unit (required for manual lines)

lineTotal.description: Total line price (auto-calculated if not provided)

currency.description: Currency code (defaults to partnership defaultCurrency or USD)

id.description: Order line identifier (used for matching existing lines)

variantPartnershipPriceId.description: Variant Partnership Price identifier (used for matching or updating)

variantId.description: Variant identifier - will be resolved to Variant Partnership Price ID (alternative to variantPartnershipPriceId)

internalReference.description: Custom internal reference (auto-generated if omitted, must be at least 1 character if provided)

currency.description: Currency code (optional, defaults to partnership defaultCurrency or USD)

locationId.description: Linked location for delivery address population

internalReference.description: Internal reference (must be at least 1 character if provided)

locationId.description: Linked location for delivery address population

properties.description: Custom JSONB properties (merged with existing properties)

lines.description: Order lines (matched by ID, variantPartnershipPriceId, or description; unmatched incoming lines are created, unmatched existing lines are deleted)

get.description: Check API health status. This endpoint does not require authentication.

post.description: Authenticate and receive a bearer token. Use Basic Authentication with your email as the username and password as the password.

get.description: Get a paginated list of products with filtering, sorting, and pagination

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of products to return

post.description: Create a new product with optional variants

get.description: Retrieve a specific product by ID with all variants

patch.description: Update an existing product with intelligent variant diffing and properties merge. Variants match by ID (priority 1) then by name case-insensitive (priority 2). Properties are merged (add/update/delete).

delete.description: Soft delete a product (marks as deleted with deletedAt timestamp without removing from database)

get.description: Get a paginated list of customers with filtering, sorting, and pagination

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of customers to return

count.description: Total number of customers matching query

post.description: Create a new customer with optional locations and contacts

get.description: Retrieve a single customer by ID with all locations and contacts

patch.description: Update an existing customer with intelligent nested resource diffing. Locations match by ID then label (case-insensitive). Contacts match by ID then name (case-insensitive). Properties are merged (add/update/delete).

delete.description: Soft delete a customer (marks as deleted with deletedAt timestamp without removing from database)

get.description: Get a paginated list of suppliers

post.description: Create a new supplier with optional locations and contacts

get.description: Get a specific supplier by ID

patch.description: Update a supplier. Include all locations and contacts you want to keep - items not in the request will be deleted.

get.description: Get a paginated list of orders with comprehensive filtering, pagination, and sorting

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of orders to return

count.description: Total number of orders matching the query

post.description: Create a new order with optional order lines

404.description: Partnership or Variant Partnership Price not found

get.description: Retrieve a single order by ID with all relations (lines, partnership info, etc.)

404.description: Order not found or has been deleted

patch.description: Update an existing order with intelligent line diffing. Lines are matched by ID, then by variantPartnershipPriceId, then by description (case-insensitive). Unmatched incoming lines are created, unmatched existing lines are deleted.

400.description: Bad request (invalid status, invalid fields, etc.)

404.description: Order, Partnership, or Variant Partnership Price not found

delete.description: Soft delete an order (marks as deleted with deletedAt timestamp without removing from database)

404.description: Order not found or already deleted

get.description: Get a paginated list of invoices

post.description: Create a new invoice with invoice lines

get.description: Get a specific invoice by ID

patch.description: Update an invoice. Include all invoice lines you want to keep - lines not in the request will be deleted.
